title: The Fire Drill Confession
logline: Michael stages a surprise fire drill "family safety" meeting that forces everyone into the parking lot, where secrets spill, Jim nearly tells Pam, and Michael admits he's lonely.
outline: A: Michael runs a surprise fire drill/"family meeting" to feel needed; he admits he's lonely. B: Jim almost tells Pam how he feels; Dwight's secret (he's secretly been drafting Michael's speeches/hiding Angela's cat) blows up. C: Andy tries too hard to be liked as fire marshal and backfires. Order: cold, A, B, C, A, B, C, A, B, A, tag
theme: Saying the thing you've been holding in
storySoFar: Michael's dinner with Jan was canceled; Jan softened. Ryan has a corporate lunch with Jan. Dwight campaigns for Assistant Regional Manager. Jim holds a real beet. Pam keeps Jim's lamp on, attends art class, and told Jim at the lake she isn't sure about the wedding. Ep 10: Michael's fire drill gathers everyone outside; Angela's secret cat in her desk is revealed, Andy's fire-marshal bid backfires, Jim nearly tells Pam but is interrupted, and Michael admits on camera the office is his family and he's lonely. Pam has not yet ended the engagement; coffee promise stands.

stateChanges.progress: Jim almost tells Pam in the stairwell/parking lot; Michael interrupts. Coffee promise still pending.
Michael admits to camera he's lonely and the office is his family; office gives a small gesture.

stateChanges.text: Angela hid a kitten in her desk drawer all episode; the fire drill exposed it. Dwight knew.
Andy tries too hard as self-appointed fire marshal; ignored, then locks himself out.

scenes.recap: Jim convinces Dwight his desk phone smells like smoke.

beats.text: Dwight, do you smell smoke?

beats.caption: sniffs the air like a bloodhound

beats.text: Yes. It's coming from the phone. Electrical fire. Or sabotage.

beats.caption: holds a smoldering birthday candle under his desk

beats.text: Everybody remain calm! I will handle this with my fire extinguisher and my body.
Dwight, it's a candle. It says Happy Birthday Stanley.

scenes.recap: Michael announces a surprise fire drill disguised as a family meeting.

beats.text: Family. Today we practice the worst day of our lives. Together. Surprise fire drill.
Actually, corporate requires notice for drills. Also an evacuation map.
Toby, there is no map for love. Or fire. Sit down.
I'm not leaving my crossword for a fake fire.
Then you will die in a real one, Stanley. Alone.

lines: People say I'm just an office manager. I'm more of a fire marshal of feelings.
Not a real marshal. That's Andy. He applied.

scenes.recap: Jim tries to say something to Pam; Angela acts strange about her drawer.

beats.text: Hey. So. Since the lake, I've kind of wanted to say something.
Yeah? Me too, actually. Maybe. Is it a coffee thing?
It's a... bigger-than-coffee thing. Well, coffee-adjacent.
Nobody touch my desk during the drill. Especially the bottom drawer.

lines: I have nothing in my drawer. Nothing that meows. Why would you ask?

scenes.recap: Andy appoints himself fire marshal and nobody listens.

beats.text: Fire marshal Bernard reporting! Everyone take a hat. Nard-Dog safety hats.

beats.caption: hands out paper hats nobody wants

beats.text: Actually, those are birthday hats from Stanley's party.
I like hat. Hat good.
Thank you, Kevin. Finally, someone with vision.

lines: I just want people to like me. And also to survive. In that order.

scenes.recap: The drill sends everyone outside; Michael demands a head count.

beats.text: THE FIRE DRILL
Head count! I want everyone on the asphalt, mourning each other.
Fifteen present. One missing. Angela.
Then she's burning! Dwight, rescue her. Take the fire extinguisher.

scenes.recap: Dwight finds Angela's secret kitten; it escapes at the worst moment.

beats.text: Angela, evacuate. Also, I know about the kitten. Everyone will.
Dwight! You promised. I'm keeping her until my cat sitter returns.

beats.caption: scoops a kitten into her cardigan

beats.text: Is that a kitten in your sweater?
It's a very small cat. Dwight smuggled her. She's his.
False. I mean, true. Fine. Her name is Sprinkles.

lines: I kept the secret all day. Angela asked me to. A good assistant keeps secrets, even when it costs him dignity.

scenes.recap: Andy locks the door and strands everyone outside.

beats.caption: locks the entrance door to seal the building

beats.text: Safety first. Nobody re-enters until I say so.
My chili is in there.
I once lived in a building like this. It burned. I was fine.
The key's inside. Oh no. Oh no, no.

scenes.recap: Jim finally starts to tell Pam; Michael interrupts.

beats.text: Pam, I've been trying to say this all day. I think you should know that I—
Everybody! Group hug! Fire is scary, and I'm lonely!
Later? Coffee. Thursday after art class?
Thursday. Yes. Good.

scenes.recap: Michael admits he's lonely and the office gives him a small gesture.

beats.text: I made this a drill because I wanted everyone in one place. That's all.

lines: I'm lonely. This office is my family. A weird family, with no mom and a lot of dads who are Stanley.
I don't need a fire. I need people who run out with me.

beats.text: Fine. I'll stand out here. Five more minutes.

beats.caption: hugs Michael, spilling a little chili

beats.text: Thank you, Kevin. That's what she said.
I am so sorry, everyone. I'll wait out here. Forever.
Good. Fire marshal goes down with the building.
